title: Manufacturing plant organisation
goal: Show plant leadership with operational and assurance functions.

rubric.must: Renee Ford is visibly the plant-manager root.
Production, Quality, Maintenance, and EHS visibly report to the plant manager.
Three separately labelled Shift A, B, and C supervisors appear beneath Production.
Mechanical and Electrical supervisors appear beneath Maintenance.
A dashed Quality release line is visually distinguishable from direct reports.
